latestRelease.title: Version 9.6.13: A Quieter Edit Session Header

items.description: The total-duration pill next to the Edit Session title is gone. The two inputs below it already show Focus and Rest time, so the pill only repeated their sum.
The objective picker no longer repeats the target icon that already sits beside the "Dungeon Objective" label. The objective name now starts at the left edge of the field.
